proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord. The union only covers spell, class_feature, and mastery. Magic items require their own top-level record kind with distinct mechanics families (passive item properties, activated item charges, etc.).
proposed_widenings.evidence: Weapon (Dagger), Rare — this is a magic item, not a spell, class feature, or mastery.

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: dawn
proposed_widenings.justification: The dagger's poison coating resets at next dawn, which is not covered by short_rest, long_rest, short_or_long_rest, or partial_short_full_long.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The weapon can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: poisoned
proposed_widenings.justification: The save gate on-fail result applies the Poisoned condition, but the Condition type currently only supports 'prone'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

proposed_widenings.name: DcSource: fixed
proposed_widenings.justification: The poison save uses a fixed DC 15 — not caster_spell_save_dc (no caster) and not weapon_attack_dc (which is 8 + ability mod + PB). A fixed numeric DC is a distinct variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: magic_item is not a UnitRecord kind in types.ts. Secondary gaps (all surface_widening level) are: dawn reset cadence, fixed DC source, and Poisoned condition. The always-on +1 attack/damage bonus is an additional passive property pattern that has no corresponding family under the existing mechanics. All secondary gaps are unreachable until the structural gap is closed. No dhall or json authored.
